text: Hi Maria! Thanks for joining this practice session. I'm going to ask you a behavioral interview question. Ready?
Yes, I am ready for the question.
Great! Tell me about yourself. Give me a brief overview of your background, experience, and what you're looking for in your next role.

Okay so, I am Maria and I am from Mexico. I study computer science in university and I graduate last year. In my last job I work as junior developer in small company. We make web applications for local business. I use React and also Node for the backend.
That's a good start! Can you tell me more about what you're looking for in your next role?

Yes, so I want to grow more as developer. In my current job, actually there is not many opportunity to learn new things because the team is very small. I want to work in bigger company where I can learn from senior developers. I am very interested on backend development and also I want to improve my English because I know is very important for work in US companies.
Thank you for sharing that. What specific technologies or projects excite you?

I like very much the microservices architecture. In my job we have monolith application and is difficult to maintain. I would like to work with microservices, maybe use Docker and Kubernetes. Also I am interesting in learn about system design because I think is important for grow as engineer. I depend of my team lead for architecture decisions now but I want to be able to make this decisions by myself.
That shows great self-awareness about your growth areas. Thank you Maria, that was a solid response!
